newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down in continuing correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down in continuing correction.

text.p: Continued correction pulled down Dhaka stocks more than two percent at close for a third straight session, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shed 76.81 points or 2.31 percent at 3,235.08. Turnover was 327.6 million taka. Of 120 traded issues, 84 lost and 36 rose.
Brokers said investors booked profit on a wide range of scrips. Beximco Pharmaceuticals was the market leader with 214,750 shares trading at 442.4, down 10.99 taka.
Beximco Pharma shed 10.99 taka to 442.40, Apex Foods lost 1,003.58 to 19,068.02 and Shine Pukur rose 23.78 to 499.43.
